title: Fridge Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Fridge compartment NTC out of range.
fullDescription: F1 on Ariston refrigerators indicates the fridge temperature probe has failed. Compressor may run continuously or cycle erratically. Sensor swap resolves most cases.

title: Freezer Sensor Fault
fullDescription: F2 means the freezer temperature sensor has failed.

title: Evaporator Sensor Fault
fullDescription: F3 indicates evaporator NTC has failed, preventing proper defrost.

title: Defrost Heater Fault
fullDescription: F4 indicates the defrost heater element or its bi-metal thermostat has failed. Evaporator ices up, cooling falls.

title: Fan Fault
fullDescription: F5 indicates evaporator fan has failed or is iced.

title: Compressor Fault
fullDescription: F6 indicates compressor start failure. Likely relay or seized compressor.

title: Door Ajar Alarm
fullDescription: F7 indicates prolonged door open state or failed door switch.

title: High Ambient Temperature
shortDescription: Room too warm for climate class.
fullDescription: F8 indicates ambient temperature is above the rated climate class. Improve ventilation or move unit.

title: Damper Fault
shortDescription: Air damper motor stuck or failed.
fullDescription: F9 indicates the fridge damper is not moving as commanded. Fridge temperature becomes uneven.

title: Control Board Fault
fullDescription: F10 indicates main PCB failure or EEPROM corruption. Power cycle may help; otherwise PCB replacement.
